notes:
- Long press, double tap and Repeat while key is held now also work when the key is pressed by another program (mouse software, Steam Input, remote desktop) - in the app and in exported .ahk macros.
- After the app starts, macros that are on are always shown ticked.
- The app checks for updates in the background every 15 minutes, so new versions no longer show up late.
- Code pasted into a script or sequence keeps its line breaks.
- New macro: the name field starts empty with a grey hint.
- Script macros show a dash instead of 'undefined' as their key.
- Help: the support link lights up when you point at it.
